message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and JSON configs directly into numpy arrays and dicts without any schema checks, dtype assertions, shape validations, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote data fetching, and therefore no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks are implemented or needed.
No detected label flipping detection: The code never validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs only a random shuffle and array conversion on CSV data; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via model.load_weights('meta/weights.hdf5') without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or custom DP mechanisms are used in any training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The test set is not cryptographically isolated or hashed; in quick_train the commented-out train/test split is unused and evaluation is performed on the same data used for training, providing no protection against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV data and user-supplied dataset names directly without any shape, range, or schema validation before passing to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs from evaluate/score/predict are used or printed directly with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used are tabular ML/DNN classifiers, not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
